scope: Independent read-only review of N06 one-condition hover suppression repair and its new regression test
analysis: After Escape, temporary is already false while matching hover suppression remains. The added disjunct permits the existing hoverLeave for that matching suppressed region, clearing the suppression so one deliberate leave/reentry can open again. The condition leaves normal permanent-region hover unchanged. Existing hoverEnter gating, 240ms delay, focus routing, preferences and cleanup behavior are unchanged. No extra listener/timer/owner is introduced.

Escape closes panel and returns focus
leave hidden panel then reenter trigger remains closed at239ms
